why: Golden re-baseline of sail-farsea / sail-k2k7 for the SailVoyage lens (option E) must use ENGINE frames with the real sea shader (Grok Bot 2026-10-26). The approach share is also arbitrated by these frames.
build: cine/sail-voyage (+ GGbot's option-E SailArt: far_meadow_impostor, seaReveal swap, lowland sink incl. meadow_river) in WeChat DevTools / web preview on the Mac
howStill: Web preview URL + ?sailshot=1&k=<k>&sailT=<t>&w=<w>&h=<h>&sailVoyage=<0|1>[&night=1]  — DevTools device = w×h, DPR 1, screenshot the canvas only (no UI). sailVoyage=0 = OLD (approved sailCamera), 1 = NEW.
howLive: Web preview + ?camTrace=1&sailVoyage=1 (and ?sailVoyage=0 for the old run): island→meadow sail once per screen; after S-g run copy(__qfCamTrace.dump()) and save as live_<w>x<h>_<old|new>.camtrace.json; record the screen at 30 fps (video_<w>x<h>_<old|new>.mp4).
name: <id>_<w>x<h>_<old|new>.png

frames.test: sail-farsea windmill share through the K3 hold
sail-voyage dock 2–4 %, windmill ≥12 px tall / ≥10 px blades on 320x568
sail-voyage open sea, whole boat in frame
swap: no meadow / stand-in pixel, no solid-colour frame

camState: sailshot: island+meadow+sail art mounted, boat at sailVehicle(t), lens = sailVoyageCamera (new) / sailCamera (old) framed for w×h; day unless night=1
deliver: /workspace/qifengle/test-reports/<stamp>_sail-voyage-capture/ (PNGs + camtrace JSON + mp4), then: node tools/sail-voyage/rebaseline.cjs <that dir>
